errorUnsupportedFileType.title: Unsupported file type
errorUnsupportedFileType.message: The file type {fileType} is not supported. Please upload a valid image file.

errorFileTooLargeSize.title: File too large
errorFileTooLargeSize.message: The file exceeds the maximum allowed size of {maxSize} MB. Please upload a smaller file.

errorInvalidFileDimensions.title: File has invalid dimensions
errorInvalidFileDimensions.message: The file has invalid dimensions. Please upload a file with dimensions from {minWidth}x{minHeight} to {maxWidth}x{maxHeight} pixels.

errorMultipleFiles.title: Multiple files selected
errorMultipleFiles.message: Please select only {maxFiles} files at a time.

errorPdfMultipleFiles.title: Multiple PDF files
errorPdfMultipleFiles.message: Please select only one PDF file at a time.

successFileUploaded.title: File uploaded successfully
successFileUploaded.message: The file has been uploaded successfully.

successFileNameUpdated.title: File name updated
successFileNameUpdated.message: The file name has been successfully changed.

errorInvalidCharacters.title: Invalid characters
errorInvalidCharacters.message: The file name contains invalid characters. Please use only alphanumeric characters, underscores, and hyphens.

errorEmptyName.title: Empty name
errorEmptyName.message: The file name cannot be empty. Please enter a valid name.

infoSameName.title: No change
infoSameName.message: The file name is the same as before. No changes were made.

successFileCopiedToClipboard.title: File copied to clipboard
successFileCopiedToClipboard.message: The image has been successfully copied to the clipboard.

errorMaxNumberOfOpenFiles.title: Maximum number of open files reached
errorMaxNumberOfOpenFiles.message: You have reached the maximum number of open files ({maxFiles}). Please close some files before opening a new one.

unsupportedPdfObjects.title: Unsupported PDF objects
unsupportedPdfObjects.message: The PDF contains unsupported graphic operators for rendering - image will be shown as a raster but operation will be performed on original pdf file.

scalePdfForBetterResolution.title: Scale PDF for better resolution
scalePdfForBetterResolution.message: For better resolution, consider scaling the PDF. This will improve the quality of the final image.

selectPdfPage.title: Select PDF Page
selectPdfPage.message: This PDF contains multiple pages. Please choose one to import.
